notes.title: Short Snow is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I can’t believe I’m actually writing this… but Short Snow is officially released on Steam!! 😭🎉

This has been a long journey , full of late nights, setbacks, and etc... and today, all of it comes together. I’m honestly beyond excited (and nervous!) to finally share this game with you all.

This is my dream project, and seeing it go live is surreal. If you’ve been following the development, supporting, or even just checking in thank you from the bottom of my heart. Your support means everything. 💖

🎮 You can play it right now!

I hope you have as much fun playing it as I did creating it.

Much love 💖

notes.title: Infection System Added & Major Bug Fixes – Short Snow Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068293/a9d058eb793842ab54ebb0989a8f2d1cfd08388c.png[/img]

Infection System Added & Major Bug Fixes – Short Snow Update!

Description:
Survivors, a new challenge awaits! The latest Short Snow update introduces an all-new Infection System, the frozen world of Short Snow just got even deadlier! Beware, infected players can now spread the virus, making every encounter a test of survival!

🦠 Ways You Can Get Infected:

- Eating uncooked meat can expose you to the virus.
- Getting attacked by animals may transfer the infection.
- Helping infected survivors around the world puts you at risk.

💉 How to Survive?

- Find and use Med Kits to heal yourself before it’s too late!
- Cook your food properly and stay alert in the wild.
- Alongside these new survival mechanics, we’ve also fixed major bugs, including vehicle driving issues and other gameplay improvements for a smoother experience.
- Now you can join the cave on the story mode.

Stay safe, stay smart, and fight to survive in this ever-evolving frozen wasteland! ❄🔥

notes.title: SnowPath: Navigate the Frost
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068293/6086058321732a6d2283ef49f814d1ce2ebc3fb2.png[/img]

Embark on a thrilling journey across a frozen wilderness in SnowPath, a short snow game featuring a cutting-edge GPS navigator and immersive full-screen map system. Chart your course and tackle icy challenges as you explore the snowy expanse. Perfect for players seeking a compact and visually stunning navigation-based adventure.

🗺️ What’s New?

Upgraded GPS Navigation: It’s smarter, smoother, and ready to guide you through those tricky snowy trails.

- Clues & Mini-Map Icons: Now you’ll spot hidden paths and challenges with ease just follow the icons and uncover the secrets of the frozen wilderness!

- Better Full-Screen Map: More immersive and more helpful than ever, making exploration feel even more natural.

- This update is all about making your snowy adventure more intuitive, exciting, and fun!

- This update includes some bug fixes too.

notes.title: Short Snow - Wilderness Update! (Big Changes)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068293/18bb09c92c27961ef2207bf7b145b72cc724d45c.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=cbxGDU1YfMA;full][/previewyoutube]

The forest is now more alive than ever!

🌲 Big Update! 🌲

The Wilderness Update has arrived, bringing a host of exciting new features and improvements to Short Snow:

🦌 Wildlife Expansion
The wilderness is now home to a variety of new animals, including rabbits, deer, bears, wolves, and more! These creatures add realism and challenge to the survival experience.

🎮 Character Overhaul
The girl character has been redesigned for a more realistic appearance, making the game world feel even more immersive.

🔫 Hunting System
The hunting system has been reworked for a deeper experience. Hunt animals for food and resources, and now you can remove skins for survival needs.

🛠️ New Items
New tools like the rifle and knife have been added to enhance your survival capabilities, making hunting  even more rewarding.

🏞️ New Environments
Explore new, dangerous landscapes with fresh challenges and rewards waiting to be discovered.

Download the Wilderness Update now and embrace the wild side of Short Snow!
🧭 Survive. Hunt. Conquer. Skin.

notes.title: New Big Update for Short Snow is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068293/493ee03307c386cdb78fb30f44f6eb41392c3ba9.png[/img]

Excited to announce a new update with awesome features and improvements. Here’s what’s new:

- Added a realistic cooking system: Now you can cook meat, fish, and more!
- Introduced a water boiling system: Boil water using campfire to stay hydrated and survive.
- You can now add sticks to campfires to improve their condition.
- Added a sleep hours system: Choose how many hours your character will sleep.
- New bedroll system: Place the bedroll anywhere to sleep on the go.
- Added new character bars UI for better visibility of player stats.
- Realistic drinking water animation.
- Bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.
- FPS improvements for better performance.

Thank you for your continued support! 
Let us know what you think of the new features, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: New Update: Bedroll Added - Rest and Recover Anywhere!
notes.content:
Survivors, Just got an exciting new addition to the game! Introducing the Bedroll, your new best friend when it comes to getting some much-needed rest in the wilderness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068293/9c97c10398d6d0dd3507907c1a63fc2eeb282ed6.png[/img]

What’s New:

Place the Bedroll Anywhere: Whether you’re deep in the forest or on the edge of a cliff, you can now place the bedroll wherever you find a flat surface.

Sleep and Recover: Once placed, simply interact with the bedroll to sleep, restoring your energy and improving your survival chances.

Strategic Placement: Use the bedroll wisely. Plan your sleeping spots to avoid danger and make sure you’re well-rested for the challenges ahead.

This update is all about giving you more control over your survival experience. So find that perfect spot, set down your bedroll, and rest easy—because the wild isn’t getting any tamer!

notes.title: Discover the Ultimate Bunker in Short Snow! 🏚️❄️
notes.content:
Have an exciting update for all Short Snow lovers! Deep within the snowy wilderness, there is hidden an incredible Easter egg - a fully stocked survival bunker! 🕵️‍♂️🗺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068293/1c7cd103f72d35c5a0f845763742fd42f8f5d339.png[/img]

What's Inside?

Abundant Food Supplies 🍲: From canned goods to preserved meats, enough to keep you well-fed for days.
Fresh Water 💧: Plenty of clean drinking water to quench your thirst.
Valuable Resources 🛠️: Essential tools and materials to craft and repair items, ensuring you’re always prepared for the harsh environment outside.

Tips for the Search:

Pay attention to unusual landmarks.
Listen for environmental sounds that might indicate a hidden entrance.
Explore thoroughly – the bunker is well-concealed!
Can you uncover the secrets of the bunker and secure your survival in the relentless cold? 🌨️

Stay tuned! Demo is coming soon!
